Method.evidence: Every row read from its own IL through NameCandidates --inspect-methods. This wave pair covers two namespaces at once: GroupTree (the group-tree folder, builder and writer around the Nodes/Node, Type, RefId, Text and GroupObjectInstances attributes) and Operations.Line (the line operations and the domain address synchronizer).
Method.line operations: AddLineOperation.CreateLine, ChangeLineAddressOperation.CreateValidators, DeleteAdditionalGroupAddressesOperation's ResetCouplerFlags and RemoveAdditionalGroupAddresses, DeleteLineOperation's AfterUndo / BeforeRedo (the b__9_1 and b__10_1 closures), MoveLineAcrossProjectOperation.MoveSegments (it runs MoveSegmentAcrossProjectOperation) and IsAffectedBusInterfaceConnector.
Method.domain addresses: DomainAddressSynchronizer.SetDomainAddress remembers the old address before applying the new one, KeepDomainAddress keeps the existing one, AssignNewDomainAddress invents one through RandomDomainAddressGenerator.InventUniqueDomainAddress, and SynchronizeSegments / AssignUniqueDomainAddresses drive the per-segment work.
